citations.quote: Curvature movement is sometimes referred to as butterfly, and attribution analysis that includes these three effects may be labelled shift-twist-butterfly
The changing shape of the yield curve can be decomposed into three different movements: shift, twist (or slope) and curvature (or butterfly).

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Nested four-curve repricing splits the sovereign-curve return into parallel shift, twist, and curvature (butterfly); the key-rate-duration partition is an alternative split that coincides exactly only via first-principles repricing.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Shift, Twist, Butterfly, and Key-Rate Duration
